description: This file defines React components related to emojis and avatars, including emoji picker and avatar display components, utilizing an external emoji picker library and custom icons.

methods.name: getEmojiUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for emoji images based on the emoji's unified identifier and style.

methods.name: AvatarPicker
methods.description: React component rendering an emoji picker with a callback for emoji selection.

methods.name: Avatar
methods.description: React component displaying a user avatar, either as a bot icon or an emoji avatar based on props.

methods.name: EmojiAvatar
methods.description: React component rendering an emoji image using the external Emoji component.
